_what: The Sam Loop reads this at the top of EVERY round. Change the number and the next round uses it - no restart, no window to find, nothing lost.
_batch: consolidate and learn every N rounds. 0 = keep playing, never consolidate. Anything broken, negative, over 200 or not a whole number is ignored and the loop keeps the size it already had.
